speaker: john_heminges
text: Paper first, and driest, under the hoops. The rolls in oiled cloth. Abel, you stay on that chest until the cloth is on.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Three books and sixty rolls are under me. Bring the cloth here. I am not standing up to be helpful and wet.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Six oars, Master Will, and myself at the stern. First of the flood. Sit trim when I say so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The paper is in before any man makes a seat of a basket. I have the near corner, Davy, as I had it on Monday.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am not a basket. Find me a dry board, grocer, or the flood will have a song it did not order.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You sit where the boat sits you. Twenty-six shillings of hose was yesterday. Today I am counting heads.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Sam stays by me. Thou wilt see a house when there is a house, and thou wilt not stand up to do it.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Is there ice?

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Westward ho! The Queen's at Windsor, there's ice at Kew, and they've made peace with Spain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three again, Davy. Row. I am not your corrector on a stair, and I will not become one in a boat.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Then keep your third and give me the gunwale. The frost is white on it. Your hand will learn.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The cloth is on. Sixty rolls. I can feel the cord through it, and I am sitting again.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Seven who share, the hired men, and three boys. If a head is short, it will be short at the other end, not mended with a speech here.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nick is in. He is not singing. Thou needst not stare at him to know it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking him for a note. Augustine has the order, and this morning is not the morning it breaks.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A further morning of virtue. I shall not applaud it where a yeoman might hear me. Shove, grocer.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Am I one of the seven? I am trying to know where I stand in a boat.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art with the boys, behind the hired men, behind the sharers. The boat does not rewrite yesterday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The scarlet on that basket is my lord's livery, folded. It is not a coat for the cold. Nobody puts it on.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have been cold in worse colours. Leave it folded. My hose are my own, and they are new, and a yeoman did not buy them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Cast off when the paper cannot see the sky. God keep the oars, Davy.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: God keep you. Sit down, the lot of you. Westward is the only wit I want from a passenger.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Heads are all in. I am not counting them a second time on the water.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Sixty rolls, and three books, and I am still the man on the chest. Cast off.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. I have seen the frost and the scarlet. I am sitting.
